text: The Philippines First Financial Sector Reform Development Policy Financing (DPF) is a programmatic initiative aimed at supporting the Philippines' financial sector reform agenda. It leverages the World Bank’s Development Policy Financing instrument to provide budget support conditioned on policy and institutional reforms. The initiative is structured around three pillars: strengthening financial sector stability, expanding financial inclusion, and catalyzing climate and disaster risk finance. The program is designed to ensure continuity and momentum of reforms through political transitions, with technical assistance from the World Bank and informed by the 2020 joint IMF–World Bank Financial Sector Assessment Program Update.
